jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.description: Responsibilities include researching, designing, implementing and validating cutting-edge algorithms to analyse diverse sources of data to achieve targeted outcomes by leveraging complex statistical and predictive modelling concepts, machine-learning approaches, clustering and classification techniques.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: In your role as Data Engineer, you will conduct innovative research leading to scientific achievements that are aligned with CSIRO's strategies. Requirements include a relevant diploma/bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant work experience in software engineering and deep expertise deploying and maintaining software on container and cloud infrastructure.

jobs.title: AI Software Engineer Summer Intern
jobs.description: requires familiarity with machine learning frameworks and cloud computing platforms, offers competitive compensation ranging from $52 to $65 per hour, and provides hands-on experience with state-of-the-art AI technologies and mentorship from leading AI researchers and engineers.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer – Data – AI Research
jobs.description: As a Research MLE at Canva, you'll be responsible for high-performance data acquisition, processing, and annotation to enable the training of cutting-edge models. Your focus will be on sourcing data, automation, building performant infrastructure for filtering and analyzing, and dealing with petabyte-scale data.

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer – Canva AI
jobs.description: You'll work on the AI that powers conversational experiences, building on top of large models and designing scalable systems that can be used across the product.

jobs.title: Graduate Data Scientist
jobs.description: You'll undertake data extraction, analysis, and modelling across a range of initiatives, and adopt Xero's standards for data excellence while learning to contribute to a cross-functional environment using modern data science and analytics principles. Requirements: Understand common statistical or machine learning concepts, have exposure to data visualisation tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI), be interested in using data to solve problems and improve decision-making, and have the ability to explain technical ideas to a non-technical audience.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Summer Intern
jobs.description: You will report to a manager in the Core Machine Learning team within the broader Analytics group, tasked to pursue business opportunities that can produce revenue or MAU improvements, working multi-functionally across the organisation. Focus on ML applications and ideas for content recommendation, personalisation, and insight generation.

jobs.title: Software Engineer – Agentforce Platform
jobs.description: You will work across the full stack, from predominantly Java (and some python) backend services running on Kubernetes to data pipelines and analytical services, delivering features that transform raw event logs into actionable process intelligence for thousands of enterprise users. You will design, implement, test, and deliver secure, highly scalable backend services and full-stack applications within a cellular, multi-tenant cloud architecture. You will develop and maintain Java-based application services (Spring Boot, Hibernate, JPA) and companion microservices for process simulation, compliance checking, and AI-powered analytics.

jobs.title: 2026 CommBank Data Science Graduate Program
jobs.description: You'll be passionate about data and excited to be at the forefront of innovation at Australia's largest Bank, working on a market-leading rotational Graduate program providing 2-3 diverse experiences where you can learn different disciplines. You'll be part of a broad team that leverages AI, data science, modelling, analytics, experimentation, behavioural science and technology to drive intelligent and ethical decisions, solutions and approaches for customers, business and communities. You'll use data to build and enhance quantitative and predictive models, large language models and chatbots and gain exposure in Decision Science, AI, Gen AI & machine learning via structured rotations, using analytical tools such as Python, AWS and Teradata.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: The company Elula was founded in 2017 by experienced professionals with a passion for AI and intelligent data use. They work with well-known Australian and international companies to solve business problems, and partner with AWS. Elula includes some of the smartest data scientists and engineers in the region, and their products utilize machine learning algorithms, productionized models, data pipelines, explainable AI, and visualizations. The job listing mentions expertise requirements in manipulating, processing, and extracting value from large, disconnected datasets.

jobs.title: NAB Graduate Program 2026 – Group Chief Operating Office
jobs.description: Business Analyst roles involve capturing and grooming requirements, assessing existing processes, producing conceptual designs and business cases, preparing reports, and managing project activities. The 15-month Graduate Program commences 16 February 2026.

jobs.title: Principal Machine Learning Scientist
jobs.description: is looking for a remote Principal Machine Learning Scientist to join the Core Machine Learning team, which builds and deploys ML modelling solutions to increase revenue generation, expand the active user base and enhance internal productivity and efficiency. The team is split geographically between Australia and the US, supporting partners across the regions. As a Principal Machine Learning Scientist, responsibilities include leading the development of advanced machine learning algorithms and leading AI/ML projects aimed at personalising recommendations.

jobs.title: 2026 CommBank Data Science and Analytics Graduate Program
jobs.description: You'll learn how to turn data into compelling stories by building and refining quantitative and predictive models, using leading-edge technology to extract and synthesise insights, and strengthen technical skills with tools like SQL, Python, AWS, and Teradata, exploring how AI-powered data capabilities can drive smarter, more efficient outcomes.

jobs.title: NLP算法工程师-AI-Lab
jobs.description: The position requires expertise in deep learning algorithms with practical project experience, proficiency in Shell/Python/C++, strong programming fundamentals, independent problem-solving abilities, and good teamwork skills. Preferred qualifications include experience with recommendation systems, computational advertising, search engines, papers published at top conferences (ICML, NIPS, ICLR, KDD, SIGIR, WWW, Recsys), and language abilities like English or Japanese.

jobs.title: 大模型应用技术研究员
jobs.description: 负责构建 LLM 相关的应用技术研究，在 Copilot/Agent、代码辅助编写、模型轻量化推理优化、便捷开发等多个领域应用落地，包括但不限于：负责基于 LLM 的 prompt 提示工程优化、DSL 定义、RAG 检索排序、精准的任务规划与工具调用能力；负责 LLM 的应用推理优化，围绕模型蜇蔗、推理加速、量化等技术；负责构建 AI 端到端工程能力，包括模型开发工具链、模型应用等。岗位要求：具备机器学习和深度学习基础，熟练掉主流大模型应用方式，包括 GPT、LLaMA、GLM 等预训练模型，精通大模型微调、量化、模型蜇蔗、推理加速等技术；跟踪国内外最新研究进展，具备快速阅读论文、复现论文能力；具有计算机科学、电子信息工程、网络协议等专业背景的名校博士；具备较强的编程能力，精通 Java/Python/Scala 中的一种或多种；在高水平国际会议和学术期刊发表过相关论文者优先。

jobs.title: 【达摩院】自然语言处理实习生 NLP算法
jobs.description: Requirements: 计算机/数学/统计系硕士及以上学历，博士优先。具有扎实的机器学习和自然语言处理理论基础；在校期间参与过自然语言处理的项目背景并取得过实际成果，熟悉文本处理的基本流程；熟悉 NLP/机器学习常用开发框架，熟悉 TF/Pytorch 等深度学习工具，有过 Java/Python/C/C++ 开发经验；有良好的自我学习能力，及自驱力。细致，耐心。有良好的团队合作能力。Team Description: 语言技术实验室是阿里巴巴负责 NLP 技术研发的核心团队，为阿里巴巴经济体提供包括 NLP 基础技术、语义计算、应用算法、机器翻译、内容搜索推荐等技术。

jobs.title: 微信大模型应用后台开发实习生
jobs.description: 职责包括参与微信大模型应用的工程设计和开发工作,包含 RAG 系统、Agent 系统、大模型分布式推理和分布式后训练相关开发工作;岗位要求计算机相关专业本科及以上学历,熟悉 linux 开发环境,熟练摀握 C++ 开发,熟悉数据结构和算法,熟练摀握至少一门脚本语言。

jobs.title: 数据算法工程师-自动驾驶（26届提前批）
jobs.description: 岗位职责包括基于海量路测和仳真数据研究自动驾驶系统评估方法、熟悉常用模型的基本原理和优缺点、推进系统安全和合规指标落地等。任职要求包括 2026 届毕业生且计算机、人工智能等相关专业硕士或博士学位优先、熟悉机器学习相关算法和流行 ML 框架如 JAX/PyTorch/TensorFlow、熟练摀握 Python/C++、了解分布式系统等。

jobs.title: 算法工程师（广告业务）
jobs.description: 成都美团广告部门招聘算法工程师，岗位职责涉及负责大规模分布式深度学习、强化学习算法研发，参与探索 NLP 领域和视觉理解等前沿技术。岗位基本需求包括具备互联网公司广告、搜索、推荐业务实践经验，熟悉摀握常用算法、深度学习等方向，熟悉工业界广告系统架构等。

jobs.title: NLP算法工程师实习
jobs.description: 岗位职责：负责百度大搜全系统语义相关性，包括但不限于 query 分析、语义相关性计算、语义召回等。工作包括大模型、小型化、生成式、预训练优化、模型新结构等。岗位要求：良好的高等数学、概率论、线性代数基础；对机器学习、深度学习、自然语言处理有深刻的理解；熟练摀握至少一种深度学习框架（PaddlePaddle、pytorch 等）；熟练摀握 Python/C++ 至少一门开发语言；有机器学习、信息检索、自然语言处理等相关顶级会议论文者优先。

jobs.title: 大模型算法工程师实习
jobs.description: 岗位职责：针对搜推业务需求，设计和实现基于大语言模型的技术方案，典型场景包括 Document QA、结构化信息抓取、知识生成等；负责大语言模型技术方案的端到端研发，包括语料库采集、数据制作、prompt tuning、指令跟随微调、领域知识注入、模型性能提升、模型效果评测等；熟悉提示工程，设计并优化模型的 prompt；跟踪业内最新研究成果，持续优化改进现有模型和技术方案。任职要求：计算机相关专业硕士及以上学历；熟悉多种 NLP 子任务（问答系统、命名实体识别、情感分析、摘要生成、知识图谱等）；对 NLP 主流预训练语言模型有深入了解（BERT/GPT/Qwen/PaLM/GLM/Bloom/LLaMA）；熟练摀握 PyTorch 和 huggingface-transformers，有大模型训练框架 Deepspeed/ColossalAI 经验者优先。

jobs.title: 大模型算法实习生（文心一言）
jobs.description: 岗位职责：参与文心一言技术建设，研发和改进现有的大模型技术，包括但不限于预训练、对齐、模型评估、Agent 系统等；推动前沿算法策略的实现与落地；跟进最前沿的大模型技术和顶会 paper。岗位要求：人工智能、计算机科学等相关专业博士、硕士研究生在读；对大模型相关技术有一定了解，有深入研究或实际项目经验者优先；熟练摀握 Python，至少摀握一款常用的深度学习框架；在 NLP 相关学术会议上发表过论文或有高质量开源项目优先；实不3个月以上，每周至少出勤 4 个工作日。
